description: This file is a C source code implementing a small pcap precompiler that generates BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) instructions based on a filter expression provided as a command-line argument. It uses libpcap functions to compile the filter and outputs corresponding C structures.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Entry point of the program; processes command-line arguments, compiles the filter expression, and outputs the generated filter instructions.
